facts.fact: Daemon serves org.bootcontrol.Manager at /org/bootcontrol/Manager on the system bus unless BOOTCONTROL_BUS=session; bus config lets any user send to the interface while only root may own the name, so per-method Polkit is the sole caller gate.

bootcontrold runs as root via D-Bus activation and systemd with ProtectSystem=full, ProtectHome, RestrictNamespaces and explicit ReadWritePaths for /boot/efi, /boot/grub, /boot/loader, /etc/default, /etc/kernel; no NoNewPrivileges or capability bounding declared.

Write methods resolve the caller via the unique sender bus name; UID comes from org.freedesktop.DBus GetConnectionUnixUser and is used only for audit/snapshot metadata, while the Polkit subject is a system-bus-name subject built from the sender.

authorize_with_polkit rejects any action outside KNOWN_ACTIONS, then calls CheckAuthorization with AllowUserInteraction and no details; any transport error maps to PolkitDenied. The polkit-mock feature replaces the check with always-Ok for known actions.

Four per-intent actions: rewrite-grub (SetGrubValue, SetGrubSettings, SetGrubDefault, RebuildGrubConfig, Add/RemoveKernelParam), write-bootloader (loader default/rename, BootOrder, BootNext), enroll-mok (BackupNvram, SignAndEnrollUki), restore-snapshot (RestoreSnapshot).

Policy file sets auth_admin for any/inactive and auth_admin_keep for active sessions on rewrite-grub, write-bootloader and restore-snapshot; enroll-mok requires auth_admin every time. Each action annotates exec.path /usr/bin/bootcontrold.

On the system bus the daemon refuses to start unless /usr/share/polkit-1/actions/org.bootcontrol.policy declares all four REQUIRED_ACTIONS (substring scan); the check is skipped entirely when BOOTCONTROL_BUS=session.

ReadGrubConfig, ReadGrubSettings, GetEtag, GetActiveBackend, ListGrubEntries, ListLoaderEntries, ReadLoaderEntry, ReadKernelCmdline, ListSnapshots, ListEfiBootEntries, GetBootOrder and GetBootNext perform no authorization or sender check and return file contents or ETags to any bus client.

Most writes call require_writable_host after Polkit to reject immutable distros; Add/RemoveKernelParam instead dispatch on probe_distro, delegating to rpm-ostree kargs on RpmOstree hosts and writing /etc/kernel/cmdline otherwise.

Environment variables BOOTCONTROL_GRUB_PATH, BOOTCONTROL_FAILSAFE_PATH and BOOTCONTROL_SNAPSHOT_ROOT relocate daemon-written paths on any bus, including production; BOOTCONTROL_UKI_DIR and ENTRY_TOKEN_PATH apply only with polkit-mock on the session bus.

Writes take a pre-write snapshot under snapshot_root before mutating; RestoreSnapshot is limited to managed_paths derived from configured grub, failsafe, grub.cfg, loader and kernel cmdline paths and requires an expected ETag.

SignAndEnrollUki constrains the target to managed_uki_dirs, a matching installation entry token, and owner UID trusted_uki_uid which production constructors fix at 0; a test builder with_uki_policy can override these.
Authorization and distro probing are routed through cfg(test) test_hooks on GrubManager; these are compiled out of non-test builds, so release binaries rely solely on authorize_with_polkit.
Each write emits Started, SnapshotTaken and Completed audit events carrying caller_uid, polkit_action and a non-cryptographic job id formed from epoch nanoseconds and pid.

gaps: No .github/workflows files in snapshot; CI privilege and release build-feature controls unverified beyond scripts/ci-local.sh.
Whether packaged release binaries are built without polkit-mock is a build/deployment unknown.
Install-time ownership and permissions of /var/lib/bootcontrol, /etc/bootcontrol and the policy file are not visible in source.
